audit.method: SHA-256 recomputed per file (tools/mk.py); Arabic image-only statement pages rendered and read by eye with Arabic-Indic digits; only identity-closing values transcribed (tools/check_transcripts.py); other files classified from rendered or text-layer covers

value_correctness.digit_note: Arabic-Indic digits on image-only pages were read from renders; several lines first read with 50 to 700 unit errors failed the arithmetic identities (total liabilities 2025, cash 2023 and 2024, CFI, operating profit and finance cost lines). Only values that close an identity (balance sheet sum, gross profit, PBT minus zakat, cash roll) are transcribed; operating profit, finance cost, CFI 2025, CFF 2025 and the H1 operating and investing cash flows are deliberately NOT transcribed because their printed digits could not be reconciled from the render. One equity-subtotal discrepancy of 500,000 in the FY2024 filing's liability components was left unresolved (total liabilities 295,642,706 closes the identity).
checks: gross profit = revenue - cost of revenue for FY2025, FY2024, FY2023, H1 2026, H1 2025, Q2 2026, Q2 2025
cash roll FY2024: 621,552 + 1,010,104 = 1,631,656 (original and re-presented); FY2025 end cash 1,258,043 ties the balance sheets of FY2025, H1 2026 comparative
EPS has two printed lines (before and after the mudaraba-instrument profit share): FY2025 3.11 and 0.96; FY2024 1.65 and (0.46); H1 2026 1.61 and 0.53
value_correctness.restatements: FY2024 re-presented in the FY2025 filing (total assets -916,365, CFO +337,000, CFI -337,000; see transcripts/5110.json). Revenue, PBT and net income unchanged.
not_read: every file other than e1494b1a, ce37febf and b415f240 (35 of 38): classified only from covers, text layers or year detection
equity statements, OCI (except FY2025 OCI page read, values not transcribed)

document_completeness.summary: Of 38 files: 15 annual reports (FY2012-FY2025, board report plus embedded statements), 6 audited statement files (FY2020, FY2021, FY2022 with garbled text, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025), 17 interim files (Q1 2021 to H1 2026). The inventory marks 17 interim/annual files partial, 2 scanned_unreadable (H1 2023, Q1 2025: fully scanned reviewed interims confirmed by rendered covers), one other_no_statements (3d02f71e, FY2022 statements with mojibake text) and classes FY2024 and FY2025 statement files as annual_report_no_statements because pages are image-only. Statement pages of every Arabic file after 2020 are image-only inside text PDFs. Collector labels follow the fiscal year here (no publication-year shift) except two files with a missing slot (2b75a707 Q1 2022, 53d30b40 Q1 2023). Units are thousand SAR, unlike the full-riyal files of the other four companies. No duplicates or wrong-company files found; the company renamed to Saudi Energy in the FY2025 statements.

annual_report_only: FY2012 to FY2019 (annual reports with embedded statements, not value-read)
absent: all interims 2012 to 2019 and Q1 2020; Q4 slots are covered only by the annual statements
company_coverage.inventory_correction: inventory expected 53 periods, counted 18 complete; collector labels are fiscal-year based so slots are not shifted. 2022|None and 2023|None are Q1 2022 and Q1 2023. Only about 3 of 25 interim/annual statement periods have values read.

defects.text: All post-2020 statement pages are image-only Arabic with Arabic-Indic digits; the text layer is a watermark or presentation-form glyph codes (3d02f71e is mojibake). Text extraction returns nothing or garbage, so these 25 statement files need OCR with Arabic-Indic digit handling plus identity checks.
Two files have no period slot (2022|None, 2023|None) and two fully scanned reviewed interims (H1 2023, Q1 2025) are classed scanned_unreadable.
Statements are in thousand SAR while other Saudi files in this batch are in full SAR; a pipeline must read the unit from the header.
FY2024 was re-presented in the FY2025 filing (total assets, CFO, CFI) and issuer name changed to Saudi Energy; EPS has two printed variants (before and after mudaraba-instrument profit share).
